instruction: Please change the background to a light pink color on all slides in my presentation.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing background color to light pink (RGB: 255, 192, 203) on all 19 slides. Uses existing evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance function to verify RGB distance from target color. Original background is white (RGB: 255, 255, 255).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly checks all slides in the presentation for background color changes
Function evaluate_presentation_fill_to_rgb_distance properly extracts slide background RGB values from both solid fills (type 1) and master backgrounds (type 5)
RGB distance calculation is semantically correct: returns normalized Euclidean distance from target pink color (255, 192, 203)
Similarity score logic is correct: 1 - average_distance gives high score when slides match target pink, low score when unchanged (white)
Expected values are accurate: target RGB (255, 192, 203) is light pink, original RGB (255, 255, 255) is white
Postconfig appropriately saves the file (Ctrl+S) before verification, ensuring LibreOffice changes are persisted
Handles edge cases: slides with no fill, master backgrounds, and normalizes distance to [0,1] range
Complete coverage: instruction requires changing all slides, evaluator verifies all slides
